name: Cron
summary: Jobs run the agent with a fixed prompt on a schedule, written either as a cron expression or in natural language ("every monday 9am", "in 30m"). Each run typically starts a fresh session and delivers its final answer to a chat or file. Agents such as Hermes Agent and OpenClaw ship this as a built-in scheduler.
how: Define a job: schedule plus prompt (via chat, CLI or the agent itself)
Scheduler parses natural language or a cron expression
At each due time, the agent runs in an isolated session
The result is delivered to the origin chat, a channel or a local file
facts: Cron expressions, intervals, one-shot times, natural language
Predictable timing, but runs whether or not there is work to do
watchOut: Needs an always-on host or a hosted scheduler
